sql: SELECT ps.cluster_label, COUNT(DISTINCT fp.posting_key) AS listings_mentioning_cluster FROM fct_posting fp JOIN posting_skills ps ON fp.posting_key = ps.posting_key WHERE fp.is_open AND fp.remote_us AND fp.is_canonical_listing GROUP BY ps.cluster_label ORDER BY listings_mentioning_cluster DESC
